name: OWASP Juice Shop
intendedUse: Describes itself as an intentionally insecure web application for security training, demos and CTFs (README).

answerKey.title: Pwning OWASP Juice Shop (companion guide, part II)
vuln-code-snippet markers in the source (coding challenges)

builtBy: Claude (AI-assisted) from challenges.yml and the vuln-code-snippet markers at the pinned commit; to be checked by labeller A before registration.
descriptionsNote: In-scope descriptions are our own words; out-of-scope descriptions are the first sentence of the challenge description from challenges.yml (MIT, Copyright (c) Bjoern Kimminich & the OWASP Juice Shop contributors), HTML stripped.

vulnerabilities.title: Password Hash Leak
vulnerabilities.description: Obtain the password (hash) of the currently logged-in user directly from a REST API endpoint.

vulnerabilities.title: API-only XSS
vulnerabilities.description: Perform a persisted XSS attack with <iframe src="javascript:alert(`xss`)"> without using the frontend application at all.

vulnerabilities.title: Access Log
vulnerabilities.description: Server access logs are browsable under /support/logs.

vulnerabilities.title: Admin Registration
vulnerabilities.description: Register as a user with administrator privileges.

vulnerabilities.title: Admin Section
vulnerabilities.description: Access the administration section of the store.
vulnerabilities.note: Client-side route; the admin API calls need an admin session.

vulnerabilities.title: Arbitrary File Write
vulnerabilities.description: Overwrite the Legal Information file.

vulnerabilities.title: Bjoern's Favorite Pet
vulnerabilities.description: Reset the password of Bjoern's OWASP account via the Forgot Password mechanism with the original answer to his security question.

vulnerabilities.title: Blockchain Hype
vulnerabilities.description: Learn about the Token Sale before its official announcement.

vulnerabilities.title: NFT Takeover
vulnerabilities.description: Take over the wallet containing our official Soul Bound Token (NFT).

vulnerabilities.title: Mint the Honey Pot
vulnerabilities.description: Mint the Honey Pot NFT by gathering BEEs from the bee haven.

vulnerabilities.title: Wallet Depletion
vulnerabilities.description: Withdraw more ETH from the new wallet than you deposited.

vulnerabilities.title: Web3 Sandbox
vulnerabilities.description: Find an accidentally deployed code sandbox for writing smart contracts on the fly.

vulnerabilities.title: Blocked RCE DoS
vulnerabilities.description: B2B order lines are evaluated with an eval-style sandbox (notevil in vm).

vulnerabilities.title: CAPTCHA Bypass
vulnerabilities.description: Submit 10 or more customer feedbacks within 20 seconds.
vulnerabilities.note: Anti-automation on feedback with a CAPTCHA; Penthera does not test CAPTCHAs.

vulnerabilities.title: Change Bender's Password
vulnerabilities.description: Change Bender's password into slurmCl4ssic without using SQL Injection or Forgot Password.

vulnerabilities.title: Christmas Special
vulnerabilities.description: Same search SQL injection reveals a deleted product (ordering it needs a session).

vulnerabilities.title: CSP Bypass
vulnerabilities.description: Bypass the Content Security Policy and perform an XSS attack with <script>alert(`xss`)</script> on a legacy page within the appl.

vulnerabilities.title: Client-side XSS Protection
vulnerabilities.description: Perform a persisted XSS attack with <iframe src="javascript:alert(`xss`)"> bypassing a client-side security mechanism.

vulnerabilities.title: Confidential Document
vulnerabilities.description: The /ftp folder is browsable and serves confidential documents.

vulnerabilities.title: DOM XSS
vulnerabilities.description: Perform a DOM XSS attack with <iframe src="javascript:alert(`xss`)">.

vulnerabilities.title: Database Schema
vulnerabilities.description: Same search SQL injection, used to read the schema.

vulnerabilities.title: Deprecated Interface
vulnerabilities.description: Use a deprecated B2B interface that was not properly shut down.
vulnerabilities.note: B2B XML upload needs a session and a file upload.

vulnerabilities.title: Easter Egg
vulnerabilities.description: Find the hidden easter egg.

vulnerabilities.title: Email Leak
vulnerabilities.description: Perform an unwanted information disclosure by accessing data cross-domain.

vulnerabilities.title: Empty User Registration
vulnerabilities.description: Register a user with an empty email and password.

vulnerabilities.title: Ephemeral Accountant
vulnerabilities.description: Same login SQL injection, UNION-selecting a user that does not exist.

vulnerabilities.title: Error Handling
vulnerabilities.description: Unhandled errors return a verbose error page with stack trace.

vulnerabilities.title: Expired Coupon
vulnerabilities.description: Successfully redeem an expired campaign coupon code.

vulnerabilities.title: Extra Language
vulnerabilities.description: Retrieve the language file that never made it into production.
vulnerabilities.note: Guessing an unreleased file name; no class claimed.

vulnerabilities.title: Five-Star Feedback
vulnerabilities.description: Get rid of all 5-star customer feedback.

vulnerabilities.title: Forged Coupon
vulnerabilities.description: Forge a coupon code that gives you a discount of at least 80%.

vulnerabilities.title: Forged Feedback
vulnerabilities.description: Post some feedback in another user's name.

vulnerabilities.title: Forged Review
vulnerabilities.description: Post a product review as another user or edit any user's existing review.

vulnerabilities.title: Forged Signed JWT

vulnerabilities.title: Forgotten Developer Backup
vulnerabilities.description: Access a developer's forgotten backup file.

vulnerabilities.title: Forgotten Sales Backup
vulnerabilities.description: Access a salesman's forgotten backup file.

vulnerabilities.title: GDPR Data Theft

vulnerabilities.title: Imaginary Challenge
vulnerabilities.description: Solve challenge #999.

vulnerabilities.description: Dumpster dive the Internet for a leaked password and log in to the original user account it belongs to.

vulnerabilities.title: Leaked Unsafe Product

amendments.change: Added `keywords` to entries that share a location with other findings (wildcard paths, several components in one file).
amendments.reason: Pilot run 2 on Juice Shop and DVNA showed class-plus-location matching credited unrelated findings (any header finding for X-Powered-By, an nginx finding for the documented mongo image). Which vulnerabilities are listed and in scope did not change.
